decisions.title: Approved existing CHALWA repository ownership and shared-service boundaries
decisions.source: ARCHITECTURE_DECISION_ALREADY_APPROVED; supplied in the AX-04 decision reconciliation instruction; original approval timestamp unavailable
statements: Canonical separate CHALWA application/repository root is /home/afuzaid/apps/chalwa.
CHALWA is the canonical writer for Design lifecycle, Product/catalog lifecycle, and storefront/order-facing CHALWA business state.
Shared identity/authentication may be reused through the explicit AFUZA identity contract; AI generation uses the shared AFUZA AI contract; shared approval/control may be consumed where applicable.
No undocumented shared database coupling; one canonical writer per domain; cross-project shared capability access uses explicit API, event, or contract boundaries.

decisions.title: Approved existing KlodHost platform ownership and development location
decisions.source: ARCHITECTURE_DECISION_ALREADY_APPROVED; supplied in the AX-04 decision reconciliation instruction; original approval timestamp unavailable
statements: Canonical separate KlodHost platform/repository root and current development location are /home/afuzaid/apps/klodhost; development domain is klodhost.afuza.id and future production brand/domain is klodhost.com.
KlodHost owns hosting, provisioning lifecycle, provider abstraction, node-agent contract, infrastructure state, and KlodHost billing-domain state.
Core architecture remains provider-neutral; Contabo is provider one, not a core-domain dependency.

Billing state and infrastructure state remain separate; tenant/customer events cannot directly execute privileged shell; shared authentication uses the explicit AFUZA identity contract; no undocumented cross-project database coupling.

decisions.title: Approved existing Marketing Agency tenant, identity, persistence, and shared-service ownership
decisions.source: ARCHITECTURE_DECISION_ALREADY_APPROVED; supplied in the AX-04 decision reconciliation instruction; original approval timestamp unavailable
statements: Canonical Marketing Agency application/repository root and development location are /home/afuzaid/apps/marketing-agency; development domain is marketingagency.afuza.id.

Marketing Agency owns Tenant, Client, TenantMembership, AccountAssignment, ServiceSubscription, AgencyTask, BillingProfile, ClientPortalConfig, and agency-specific business state in its own persistence boundary.
Use shared AFUZA identity/auth when compatible; Marketing Agency does not create a second canonical identity system.

Shared Acquisition Engine canonically owns Campaign, Lead, LeadScore, qualification, suppression, outreach, WhatsApp, and acquisition analytics. Approval is the shared control capability; AI generation is AFUZA AI; landing-page generation is shared AFUZA LP; creative/video is Creative OS where used.
Shared-domain records remain owned by their canonical services. Integrations use explicit contracts, APIs, events, or references; no undocumented cross-project database writes.
